title: Finite Monoid Computations and a Uniform Generalized Star-Height Bound
summary: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has a generalized regular expression of star height at most thirteen over that same alphabet. We prove this uniform bound by representing finite monoid computations as affine updates and recovering them through twelve successive split constructions.
family_title: Generalized star height at most three

review.reason: Proves a uniform star-height bound for generalized regular expressions via monoid computations.
